catalysts.name: Ecolab Inc.
catalysts.what: Wells Fargo analyst Jason Haas upgraded Ecolab to Overweight from Equal Weight and raised the price target to $380 from $315 on 13 Nov, about 27.8% above today's $297.32 price - citing AI data-center demand for Ecolab's Global High-Tech water/cooling business and pricing surcharges persisting into FY2027. Street consensus is more measured (~$332-333 average target, Moderate Buy), so this is one bullish desk's target, not a reconciled consensus. Shares are little changed today (-1.1%) against the broad market selloff.

catalysts.name: Palo Alto Networks, Inc.
catalysts.what: Palo Alto Networks reported fiscal Q1 2027 results on 18 Nov: non-GAAP EPS $1.05 vs $0.97 consensus, revenue $3.44B vs $3.31B expected, Next-Gen Security ARR +66% to $9.73B. The company said it was "materially raising" full-year guidance, lifting FY2027 non-GAAP EPS to $4.26-$4.30 and revenue growth to 26-27%. Shares are up 6.4% today to $361.73, a notable divergence given the broad AI/tech-stock selloff elsewhere in the market.

ECL.what: Provides water treatment, hygiene and infection-prevention products and services to industrial, foodservice, healthcare and life-sciences customers worldwide.

PANW.what: Cybersecurity platform provider offering next-generation firewalls, cloud security (Prisma) and AI-driven threat detection (Cortex) for enterprises and government agencies worldwide.
